handback.t:
The withholding-tax reclaim MVP is built, committed and pushed to origin (master, commit fbf4a4b) in C:\Users\mariu\ventures\withholding-tax-reclaim. 31 pytest tests pass offline, run with the freight-recovery .venv (Python 3.14, same pinned versions). I did not run docker build, docker compose, live uvicorn or the PDF ingest path, since there is no PDF fixture; the CI workflow includes a docker build.

**What it does**
- **Flow:** ingest takes PDF text layer, CSV or TXT and records a sha256 of the original bytes. A swappable extraction provider turns each document into a payment advice or tax voucher. The default is a deterministic offline `Key: Value` stub; the LLM provider is a placeholder that raises `NotImplementedError`.
- **Rules:** `rules/engine.py` computes reclaimable as withheld minus gross times the treaty rate, floored at 0 and rounded half-up, all in `Decimal`. The filing deadline is Dec 31 of payment year plus a per-market number of years, compared with an injectable `as_of` date. It reports open, due soon or expired.
- **Checks:** required fields, market in scope, known treaty rate, withheld versus statutory rate, ISIN versus market, deadline, and voucher consistency. Anything doubtful is flagged for review instead of guessed, and a person always reviews. Nothing is filed.
- **Output:** a JSON and markdown evidence packet with sha256 per source document, step-by-step calculation, checks and outstanding items, plus a DRAFT reclaim cover sheet that is not an authority form. Both the FastAPI app and the CLI (`--as-of`, `--json`) run the same pipeline.

**Scope and tax content**
- **Markets:** four example markets (DE, FR, CH, ES), investor residences US, GB, NO and SE, dividend and coupon income.
- **Out of scope:** IT, PT and GR are assumed to need wet-ink originals or a local agent. They are flagged `out_of_scope` and never calculated.
- **Illustrative only:** every rate, deadline and "fully digital" assumption is labelled illustrative, not tax advice and unreviewed by a tax professional, in code, packets, API docs and README. The digital-filing assumption for the in-scope markets is itself unverified, and accuracy is unmeasured.

**Repo contents**
- **Docs and deploy:** README MVP section, ARCHITECTURE.md, deploy/aws.md (ECS/Fargate plus RDS), a Terraform skeleton, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml and a CI workflow. Nothing was provisioned and no [SENSITIVE_PATH] are stored.
- **Pinned deps:** same as freight-recovery, no pandas, and no "ruflo" or "ruvnet" anywhere in the repo.
- **Tests:** two synthetic fixtures (US investor with a German dividend in TXT, GB investor with a Swiss dividend in CSV) plus inline edge cases.
- **TODO list:** custodian and sub-custodian feeds, per-market e-filing, local-agent handling, payments and reconciliation, auth and tenancy, audit log, a real treaty-rate data source, OCR, and a real LLM provider.

My commit also touched five existing files (business/business-plan.md, fundraising/README.md, hiring/README.md, technical/README.md, technical/overview.md). The only change I can see is Windows line-ending normalization; I did not edit their content.
